market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a minor political figure, leader of the MBL movement, with limited national recognition. The 2026 Brazilian presidential election will likely feature strong major-party candidates, making it highly improbable for Santos to secure second place. The market's 5.5% implied probability significantly overstates his true chances.
evidence_points: Santos has never held a high-profile elected office and lacks a broad electoral coalition.
Historical first-round results show second place goes to major party candidates.
Preliminary polls and political analysis do not include Santos as a leading contender.
sources_consulted: Brazilian political analysis articles (Folha de S.Paulo)
